title: TS-43 Gate round 2A: fix the mutation-confirmed weak features
description:
Source: the fresh re-audit report at /tmp/ts/reaudit.md (read the per-feature blocks for your features). Rules: features stay the spec (Gherkin text of existing scenarios unchanged); cucumber-js steps drive production code; every fixed or new scenario group gets a recorded mutation check (break production, scenario fails, restore); no new Python; push with an explicit refspec (git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>), never plain git push.

Fix each WEAK finding the re-audit proved by mutation: (1) computer_affinity, bot_turns, job_routing: removing the computerId filter in assignTurn leaves all green; add a worker on a different computer with a fresher heartbeat and assert the pinned turn skips it. (2) tenant_isolation scenario 1 passes with tenant filtering broken because the computer pin rescues it; use a non-computer capability. (3) page_content_authority, prompt_injection_containment, browser_context_policy, task_authority_grant: removing the tool-granted check leaves all green; add a scenario requesting an ungranted tool on a granted origin (a new ported feature file is fine; do not duplicate capability_policy_isolated_checks). (4) integration_test_auth: skipping the HMAC compare stays green; add a tampered-signature scenario. (5) web_turn_grant: renaming run_terminal in web/lib stays green because web/test-support/membership-ui-harness.ts:666 reimplements it; make the harness call the lib. (6) computer_host_disk_lifecycle: with hydrate's unpack removed the survive-a-recycle scenario still passes; clear the local disk first. (7) organizations: the store-is-recycled step body is empty; reset scenarioMessagingStore.
right_now_summary: The team is strengthening weak tests across routing, security, authentication, and lifecycle handling.
